lines.zh: 我一步一顿地走，关节在响。
lines.en: I walk in jerks, my joints clanking.
My iron feet crush the gravel.
I move toward my summoner.
My head turns before my body does.
A pipe on my back vents steam.
I drag my heavy steps.
I route around a pit.

lines.zh: 我的手指一下一下开合。
lines.en: My fingers open and close.
I halt and wait for orders.
I advance three more steps.
The brass plates on me rattle.
I come your way.
Each step leaves a print.
I come from the workshop side.
I stand, steam leaking from the seams.
My eyes brighten and dim.
I wait for the next command.
My gears turn slowly.
I do not know what to do.
My arms hang at my sides.
I stand still, waiting for a pat.
There are hammer marks on my shell.
I recalibrate once more.
I turn my head to you, half a beat late.
You are not my summoner.
My lens points at you.
I am comparing faces.
You carry no hammer.
I wait for you to give an order.

lines.zh: 我的镜片对着你，转了两圈。
lines.en: My lenses turn twice, fixing on you.
My pipes hiss.
I ring like struck metal.
A plate of iron falls off me.
I step back, joints clattering.
I vent a burst of steam.
Two screws work loose.

lines.zh: 我低头，铁皮上多了道凹痕。
lines.en: I look down: a new dent in my plating.
Function is unaffected.

lines.zh: 我重新校准了重心，站稳。
lines.en: I recalibrate my balance and steady myself.
I log that damage.
My lens dimmed for half a second.

lines.zh: 我是铁做的，不吃你手上那个。
lines.en: I'm made of iron; I don't eat that.

lines.zh: 工程师的锤子造的我，别乱举。
lines.en: The engineer's hammer made me — don't wave that.
My boiler does not need that.
I look and do not react.
Set it beside me.
That will not power me.
I shake my head and a joint clanks.
I was hammered into being.

lines.zh: 我不吃，锅炉也不烧这个。
lines.en: I don't eat, and my boiler won't burn it.
You hit me like an iron block.
Steam puffs onto you.

lines.zh: 你退开半步，我的铁皮没凹。
lines.en: You step back; my plating stays unmarked.

lines.zh: 我的外壳凹了，齿轮还在转。
lines.en: My shell dents, but the gears still turn.
I put a hand out to steady you.

lines.zh: 我的蒸汽挡住了视线，抱歉。
lines.en: My own steam blocked my sight — sorry.

lines.zh: 铁皮碰撞，请勿投诉噪音。
lines.en: Sheet-metal collision — please don't file a noise complaint.

lines.zh: 让开，我的路线是工程师画的。
lines.en: Out of the way — my route was drawn by the engineer.
An engineer built me.
A tin thing knows only its summoner.
I only need tightened screws.
I stood in the workshop a long time.
She pats me and I clang.
I remember her voice.
After she leaves, I wait.

lines.zh: 工坊空了，我还在原地站着。
lines.en: The workshop is empty; I still stand here.
The steam slowly fades.

lines.zh: 我用两根铁指夹起它，很轻。
lines.en: I pinch it between two iron fingers; light.
I hand it to my summoner.
Could this be traded for parts?
I look at the markings.

lines.zh: 它在我掌心烧得嗤嗤响。
lines.en: It hisses and burns in my palm.
I stow it in my chest compartment.
I squeeze once and it dents.

lines.zh: 我是工程师之锤敲出来的。
lines.en: The engineer's hammer made me.
I am not good with small things.
Threat confirmed.
My eyes turn red.
My summoner does not object.
Boiler pressure is rising.
I raise my arm.

lines.zh: 锅炉压力够了，我准备好了。
lines.en: Boiler pressure is up; I am ready.

lines.zh: 召唤者没下令，但我不喜欢这样。
lines.en: My summoner gave no order, but I dislike this.
You should stop now.
Please step back.
I track your movement.
My calculations lag behind you.
My feet slip on the ground.
I recalibrate the heading.
Your movements follow a pattern.
I have learned it.
I crowd you toward the wall.
The steam blocks my view.
I take another step.
The gears engage.

lines.zh: 我抬起另一只手，蒸汽喷出来。
lines.en: I lift my other arm and vent steam.
I bring my fist down.
My iron fingers graze you.
I ram forward.
My hammer arm catches you.
That one was not very accurate.
You block it and your arm goes numb.
I add a kick.
My joints are overheating.

lines.zh: 你一退，我的铁拳砸在墙上。
lines.en: You step back; my iron fist hits the wall.
I stop and recalculate.
Steam bursts in my face.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的肩，关节咔咔响。
lines.en: I grip your shoulder, joints clicking.

lines.zh: 工程师的锤子敲了三下，我站起来。
lines.en: The engineer's hammer struck three times and I rose.
I rise from the workshop floor.
My gears mesh for the first time.
My boiler ignites.
Steam bursts from my back.
I look at the one who called me.

lines.zh: 我的第一道命令还没到。
lines.en: My first order has not arrived.
I stand in this clearing.
I plant my feet.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛亮起红光，锅炉点着了。
lines.en: My eyes glow red; the boiler catches.
There is one more iron thing here.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的外壳，我冒汽。
lines.en: Fire heats my shell and I steam.
I hit the ground and one leg buckles.

lines.zh: 水进了我的锅炉，我熄了。
lines.en: Water gets into my boiler and I go out.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，零件散了几块。
lines.en: The blast flips me and several parts scatter.

lines.zh: 一支箭卡在我的关节里。
lines.en: An arrow jams in my joint.

lines.zh: 咒光烧坏了我的一块线路。
lines.en: Spell-light burns out a circuit.

lines.zh: 我没有燃料，动作在变慢。
lines.en: No fuel; my movements slow.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我一阵乱抖。
lines.en: Lightning hits and I jerk wildly.
I fall, and the steam stops.
